content.headline: Aster Vacuum 3 Priced at 259 USD, Specs Revealed
content.body:
The Aster Vacuum 3, the latest model from the tech company Aster, has been officially priced. According to the company's announcement, the device carries a list price of 259 USD. This places it in the mid-range segment of the market, appealing to consumers seeking advanced features without a premium cost.

The vacuum features improved suction technology and a longer battery life compared to its predecessor. It also includes a smart sensor system that adjusts power based on floor type. Pre-orders begin next week, with shipping expected shortly thereafter. The Aster Vacuum 3 is available in two color options: graphite and silver.
